name: Tree
description: Provides cover to operatives with bases of 28mm or less. If there are two intervening trees, operatives are obscured regardless of their size.

name: Fruit Tree
description: Provides cover to operatives with bases of 28mm or less. Operatives that finish a move action within control range of a fruit tree can harvest it, restoring 1D3+1 wounds or adding 1 Fruit to their inventory. If there are two intervening trees, operatives are obscured regardless of their size.

name: Bush
description: Provides cover to operatives with bases of 28mm or less on conceal order, can be traversed without penalty.

name: Mushroom
description: Operatives that finish a move action within control range of a mushroom can harvest it, restoring 1D3+1 wounds or adding 1 Mushroom to their inventory.

name: Flower Bush
description: Provides cover to operatives with bases of 28mm or less. Operatives that finish a move action within control range of a flower bush can harvest it, adding 1 poison flask to their inventory.
